name: Shinomiya Yoruko
source:
Role: Knight

She is the brave knight who fought alone against a gigantic Kyojin. She ended up injured and unconscious so [url=/c1435]Akihito[/url], who happens to witness the encounter, helped her. Though thankful for his deed, Yoruko doesn't get along well with her savior. She is also part of [url=/c1655]Gasai Itsuki[/url]'s coμ.
